# Ahmed Banko

> Personal portfolio of Ahmed Banko — a London-based Full Stack Software Engineer and AWS certified cloud specialist. First-Class Honours BSc in Computer Science from King's College London. Currently Senior Software Engineer at Paperplanes UK, building data-driven personalised direct mail systems that integrate with platforms like Shopify and Klaviyo.

This site is a single-page React application; the URLs below are the canonical entry points for each section. Crawling any of them returns the same HTML shell with full metadata, JSON-LD `Person` and `WebSite` schema, and a `<noscript>` fallback summarising the content of every section.

## Pages

- [About](https://ahmedbanko.com/): Introduction, background and current role.
- [Projects](https://ahmedbanko.com/projects): Selected software projects, including LoyaltiesHub, RIMP, Bicycle Trip Planner, Chess Clubs Management System and Qamislo XE.
- [Tech Stack](https://ahmedbanko.com/stack): Technologies and tools — AWS, Docker, OpenAI API, Dagster, Django, PostgreSQL, Python, Node.js, React, Java, Tailwind, Git and more.
- [Experience & Education](https://ahmedbanko.com/experience): Roles and degrees, including Paperplanes UK and King's College London.
- [Why Hire Me](https://ahmedbanko.com/why-me): Technical strengths and soft skills.
- [Contact](https://ahmedbanko.com/contact): Email, LinkedIn, GitHub and CV download.

## About the author

Ahmed Banko is a Full Stack Software Engineer based in London, UK. He is AWS certified and specialises in building scalable, resilient, data-driven systems across cloud, DevOps and full-stack web. He is multilingual: fluent in English, Kurdish, Arabic and Turkish.
